probes.name: s1-012-granularity-beta-adversarial
probes.cases: mirror-collapse (n_independent==1,never 2); granularity invariance; SCEN-1/2/3 Sybil/collusion; Beta sensitivity table

limitations: Beta/EigenTrust is recommendation only, never enforcement; no automatic trust enforcement is claimed.
Numeric thresholds (P[theta>0.9] >= 0.95; r_min 28/41 at lambda 0/0.02) are modeling assumptions, not corpus-validated calibrations.
Decay and the planning threshold must be calibrated together against an incident corpus (at lambda=0.05 the threshold is unreachable).
Literature (reputation systems, EigenTrust) verified by offline bibliographic/official-documentation review; no live network fetch.
Auditor is a process-separated role within one local environment, not an external human or independently operated model.
note: S1-012 authored + validated: bundle.json with 12 verified sources (5 classes), ̨18 claims, ̨11 artifacts; probes granularity-beta-adversarial 25/25 + acceptance-criteria 18/18. Mirror-collapse: two mirrors of the same publisher = ONE independent unit (n_independent==1), document/span/digest granularity invariant; colluding cluster without pretrusted anchor only a flagged recommendation (enforcement=false). Beta sensitivity (a0=b0=1): P[theta>0.9]>=0.95 at r=28 (lambda=0)and r=41 (lambda=0.02); unreachable at lambda=0.05 — decay+threshold calibrated together. research-plan PASS is a research evaluation;it never sets Goal ACCEPTED (release gate only.
